title.zh: Weideman 有限谐波动理学色散

summary: Assemble the Maxwellian 3x3 kinetic tensor by finite cyclotron-harmonic sum with the source's positive near-zero kz clamp.

identity.relation: SI species and wavepoint to dielectric and dispersion tensors and determinant
identity.direction: SI species and wavepoint to dielectric and dispersion tensors and determinant
identity.definition: Sum harmonics -lmx..lmx using scaled Bessel Gamma terms and N=64 Weideman Z; D adds Maxwell curl terms to K and determinant=det(D).
identity.coordinates: wavevector in the x-z plane, with z parallel to B0
identity.boundary: abs(kz)<1e-10 is replaced by +1e-10 before all resonant divisions
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: 背景磁场强度，决定回旋频率
inputs.constraints: 有限且非零，回旋频率正比于 B0。

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: 各组分电荷，决定回旋频率符号
inputs.constraints: 有限，元素数与其余组分数组一致。

inputs.name: ms
inputs.description: 各组分质量，进入热速度与回旋频率

inputs.name: ns0
inputs.description: 各组分绝对数密度，进入等离子体频率

inputs.name: Ts0
inputs.description: 各组分温度，已按源码约定换算为开尔文

inputs.name: f
inputs.description: 电磁波频率，转换为角频率后进入共振分母与归一化折射率
inputs.constraints: 有限且非零，omega 作除法。

inputs.name: kz
inputs.description: 波矢平行磁场分量，进入平行共振宗量与 Maxwell 旋度项
inputs.constraints: 有限；冻结源码在除法前把 `abs(kz)<1e-10`（包括 `kz=0`）钳位到 `+1e-10`。

inputs.name: kx
inputs.description: 波矢垂直磁场分量，给出贝塞尔宗量与折射率

inputs.name: lmx
inputs.description: 贝塞尔谐波截断阶数，求和范围为 $|n|\le$ `lmx`
inputs.constraints: 可选，默认 5（与源码 frozen source 一致），必须为非负整数。

outputs.name: K
outputs.shape: `(3, 3)` 复数矩阵，分量轴序为 x、y、z
outputs.constraints: 有限复数，非对角反对称对满足 $K_{yx}=-K_{xy}$、$K_{zy}=-K_{yz}$。

outputs.name: D
outputs.description: 加入 Maxwell 旋度项的色散张量，即色散关系所在的矩阵
outputs.shape: `(3, 3)` 复数矩阵，分量轴序为 x、y、z

outputs.name: determinant
outputs.description: 色散行列式 $\mathcal{D}=\det D$，其零点给出本征模

outputs.name: omega
outputs.description: 由输入频率换算的角频率

outputs.name: wcs
outputs.description: 各组分含符号回旋频率

outputs.name: wps2
outputs.description: 各组分等离子体频率平方

outputs.name: lmx
outputs.description: 本次实际使用的谐波截断阶数，回显输入

outputs.name: tensor_convention
outputs.description: 张量约定的文字标识，供调用者核对符号

preconditions: Species arrays are finite, non-empty and shape-compatible; masses, densities and temperatures are positive, with nonzero charge and magnetic field.
The wavepoint and derived frequency/scales are finite and satisfy the selected numerical path domain.
supported: Assemble the Maxwellian 3x3 kinetic tensor by finite cyclotron-harmonic sum with the source's positive near-zero kz clamp.
excluded: Mode identification, root finding and accuracy outside the tested finite-harmonic or rational-pole approximation.
Inputs that violate the numerical domain or require a different tensor convention.

failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative root solve is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

python.signature: evaluate_fluidbw_kinetic_dispersion_sum(*, B0, qs, ms, ns0, Ts0, f, kz, kx, lmx=5)

example.description: Evaluate the finite-harmonic Maxwellian tensor at one bounded wavepoint.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_fluidbw_kinetic_dispersion_sum
r=evaluate_fluidbw_kinetic_dispersion_sum(B0=1.0, qs=[-1.60217662e-19], ms=[9.1094e-31], ns0=[6.075e19], Ts0=[11604941.036704937], f=1e10, kz=1.0, kx=1.0); assert r['D'].shape==(3,3)
example.expected: Observed PASS: the finite-harmonic case returns finite 3x3 K and D tensors, determinant, species scales, and lmx=5.
